description: This file defines a class 'Values' which serves as a base class for holding internal property values of a DocumentObject in the MigraDoc library, including clone functionality and references to associated objects.

classes.name: Values
classes.description: Base class for all classes that hold the values of a DocumentObject, providing cloning and references to related objects.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a shallow copy of the current Values instance, resetting the Owner reference.
